 Odisha schools shut in six districts till November 21 amid cyclone storm ‘Akvan’
 Odisha schools shut in six districts till November 21 amid cyclone storm ‘Akvan’
 Vishnukumar V | November 18, 2026 | 10:09 PM IST | 1 min read
 Schools in six districts will remain shut for three days, while institutions in Khordha will close for two days as a precautionary measure.
 Schools in seven Odisha districts will remain closed as a precautionary measure amid Cyclonic Storm Akvan. (Representative Image: Pexels) Schools across seven districts in Odisha will remain closed on November 19 and 20, while institutions in six of these districts will also observe a holiday on November 21, in view of Cyclonic Storm Akvan.
 The School and Mass Education Department, Odisha, announced the closure of all government, aided and private schools in Ganjam, Gajapati, Puri, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapada and Kandhamal districts from November 19 to 21.
 Also read 1 in 5 Indian children live below poverty line; at 21%, poverty rate highest among the uneducated: World Bank 
 Odisha schools holiday in Khordha district
 In Khordha district, all government, aided and private schools will remain closed on November 19 and 20.
 The department shared the announcement through its official X handle, @SMEOdisha, stating that the closures were ordered as a precautionary measure to ensure the safety of students in view of the cyclonic storm.
 The school closure applies to all government, aided and private schools in the districts mentioned in the announcement. The department has not specified any changes to the school schedule beyond these dates in its post.
